purpose: Manual six-direction semantic evaluation, not exact-match gold translations. Supplied aligned translations can disagree; judge each source independently. No model evaluation has been run.

targetCriteria.th: Omit obvious person pronouns and possessives; preserve needed register without guessed gender or particle quotas.
targetCriteria.ja: Omit recoverable subjects while preserving contrast and evidenced politeness; no invented gender or rank.
targetCriteria.en: Use necessary grammatical subjects/pronouns and natural fragments; preserve meaning.
